Mapid.description: BLOCK71 Bandung-resident Indonesian geospatial-intelligence startup (PT Multi Areal Planing Indonesia, led by Bagus Imam Darmawan) building GEO MAPID — a cloud GIS platform for collecting, managing, visualizing and analysing geospatial data, plus a community/competition layer for non-GIS-experts. Finalist of Making Indonesia 4.0 Startup4Industry (2018). Drop generic 'map ID' / map-API mentions.
